data.title: City Walk Northline
data.about:
Welcome to Citywalk Northline, the newest addition to Dubai's City Walk, offering a curated selection of residences by Meraas. Northline Citywalk introduces luxurious 1 to 3 bedroom apartments across ten meticulously designed floors. Citywalk Northline is ideal for those desiring an authentic urban lifestyle, providing awe-inspiring views of Downtown Dubai and Jumeirah. It perfectly blends the city's energy with the calm of home.

At Citywalk Northline, you gain more than just a residence; you're offered a portal to a refined lifestyle in the bustling heart of Dubai. Embrace an unparalleled living experience where sophistication meets convenience, all within the vibrant Citywalk Northline community. Leveraging the latest technology, Citywalk Northline apartments elevates your lifestyle to the forefront of modernity. The development's specifications, styling, fittings, and finishes are exquisitely crafted, ensuring a flawless living environment.

Citywalk Northline stands proudly in the heart of City Walk, providing a prestigious address and seamless connectivity to all of Dubai's prime areas. The location ensures you're always just moments away from the city's essential social amenities.

Thanks to Citywalk Northline's strategic location, robust transportation services, including the City Walk bus services and the nearby Burj Khalifa metro station (just 7 minutes away), are at your disposal. This makes exploring Dubai's notable landmarks and attractions effortless from your Citywalk Northline residence.
